Description
This sun-filled 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom and den located in Kitsilano, Vancouver furnished condo rental has Hardwood floors, stylish, high-end Luxury furnishings from INspiration Furniture store, including Natuzzi white leather Couch and accent chair. You will appreciate ample natural light in the den or watch Netflix or cable TV sitting on the comfy couch next to the gas fireplace in the comfort of the living room or dining at the glass dining table. The kitchen features a generous layout with Quartz counter tops, stainless steel appliances and tile flooring for easy cleaning. The den has a at home office which can be fully closed off for privacy, and includes a large working desk.

Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Conveniently located in MacKenzie Heights with easy access to Dunbar, Kerrisdale, and Arbutus. Close to shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, and other everyday amenities. Easy access to major transportation routes and nearby neighbourhoods. Approximately 3,105 sqft. of finished living space, fully furnished with luxury furniture, offering a comfortable and elegant living environment. 3 levels w/ 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Spacious living & dining rooms on the main floor. Den on the main floor. Kitchen w/ Refrigerator, stove, oven, dishwasher. Powder room on the main floor. Partially finished basement with a recreation room & additional bedroom. 1 fireplace. Mixed flooring including carpet, hardwood, & ceramic tile. Forced-air heating. 1 covered parking stall. Washer and dryer included.
